description: Proceeds from selling private company shares on the secondary market: sale price after a discount (or premium) to the last round price or a valuation, fees, net proceeds, gain over cost basis and the implied company valuation. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/secondary-sale-calculator

cost_basis_usd.description: Total cost basis of the shares sold.

discount_pct.description: Discount to the reference price, percent. Negative for a premium.

fees_pct.description: Broker or platform fees, percent of gross proceeds.

fully_diluted_shares.description: Company fully diluted shares. Required for the valuation basis; optional otherwise.

price_basis.description: "price": reference is the last preferred price per share. "valuation": reference is a company valuation divided by fully diluted shares.

reference_price_per_share_usd.description: Last preferred price per share (price basis).

name: secondary_sale
title: Secondary sale calculator
